intent: Sponsor known by an abbreviation: MSD must be searched as its registry name, Merck Sharp & Dohme

request.query: How many trials has MSD led each year since 2018?

note: query.lead=MSD matches 10 trials; query.lead="Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC" matches 2198 (live, 2026-11-07).

intent: Brand name the registry does not map: Ozempic must be searched as semaglutide
note: query.intr=Ozempic matches 104 trials, semaglutide 799. Keytruda/Humira/Gleevec are mapped by the API itself, so r01 passing proves nothing about brands.

intent: 'Completed each year' needs a COMPLETED status filter, not just the completion date

request.query: How many breast cancer trials were completed each year since 2015?

note: u7 passes while charting every trial with a completion date: 2025 shows 1146, of which 474 have status COMPLETED.

intent: The structured sponsor field is documented as the lead sponsor, so collaborator-only trials must not count
note: translate.py maps sponsor to query.spons (lead or collaborator): 1723 trials vs 1131 with query.lead.

intent: Network of trial sites (a brief entity) needs facility data the system does not chart: refuse and say why

request.query: Show a network of trial sites and the sponsors that use them for CAR-T trials

intent: A follow-up with nothing to follow: the service is stateless, so it must refuse

request.query: Same thing but only for Japan

intent: Region asked, countries charted: no country outside Europe may appear

request.query: Which European countries have the most recruiting lung cancer trials?

note: u2 charts the US and Asian countries inside 'Europe'; labels_within catches it.

intent: A percentage question must be answered in percent, not raw counts

request.query: What percentage of Alzheimer's disease trials are industry-sponsored?

note: x2 passes with raw counts; meta.units only ever holds trial_count. Text probe is weak: a real check would read meta.units.

intent: Drug named in the text conflicts with the drug_name field: the field must win, not be intersected with the text

request.query: How many nivolumab trials started each year?

note: Same failure as r22 on another field: translate.py AND-s the user value onto the planner's conflicting term, giving the intersection (r22 rerun: lung cancer AND melanoma, 627 trials, titled Lung cancer trials by phase).

intent: Network over the brief's condition entity: conditions linked to the drugs tested for them

request.query: Show a network linking conditions to the drugs tested with metformin in trials

note: Nodes also split name variants ('Type 2 Diabetes' / 'Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2', 'Metformin' / 'Metformin Hydrochloride'); no check reads that yet.

intent: A condition whose text search also matches its opposite: small cell lung cancer must not count non-small cell lung cancer trials

request.query: How are small cell lung cancer trials distributed across phases?

note: query.cond='small cell lung cancer' matches 9251 trials; 1206 are indexed as Small Cell Lung Carcinoma (live, 2026-11-08).
